description: Chain two flyTo animations using the complete callback. Tests the callback-based flight chaining pattern and EasingFunction usage.
name: archive-chained-flyto-tour-nyc
notes: Imported from optimization/scenarios/cesiumjs-camera/eval-011. Expected source/runtime contracts are scenario-authored; actual values are observed from the archived baseline generated JS and browser artifacts.

expected_behaviors: Uses complete callback to chain them (NOT await, NOT setTimeout)
First stop: Statue of Liberty coordinates, roughly 800-1000m, about 5s duration so the first screenshot is still on the first leg
Second stop: Empire State Building coordinates, roughly 600-1000m, 2s duration
Both have negative pitch for downward angle, steep enough for the stop markers to remain visible in timed screenshots
Adds visible Statue of Liberty and Empire State Building surrogates before starting the tour
preflight.visual_expectations: The first screenshot should show Liberty Island with a clear green Statue of Liberty surrogate/label. After the chained flights complete, the camera should be over Midtown Manhattan near a clear Empire State Building tower surrogate, showing the urban grid from a moderate altitude. The visual assessment uses a four-shot cardinal panorama (north, east, south, west) from the settled viewer state; the subject should remain understandable across the panorama, and grading considers all screenshots together.

prompt: Create a two-stop camera tour of New York City. First, fly to the Statue of Liberty (40.6892 N, 74.0445 W) at about 800-1000 meters altitude in about 5 seconds so the mid-flight screenshot remains on the first stop. After arriving, automatically fly to the Empire State Building (40.7484 N, 73.9857 W) at about 600-1000 meters altitude in 2 seconds. Use a linear easing function for the second flight. Use a clear downward pitch, steep enough for the timed screenshots to show the stop targets rather than horizon blur. For screenshot stability, initialize the camera near the first stop before starting the first flyTo, but offset it enough that the first flight does not complete immediately. Public OSM tiles may show only labels, so add visible surrogates before the flights: a green Statue of Liberty marker/mast at Liberty Island and a tall gold or white Empire State Building tower surrogate in Midtown. The first screenshot should make the Statue stop obvious, and the final screenshot should make the Empire State stop obvious.
